682:t_2:29.en:
$$ベック$$
「More importantly, you absurdly huge little lady over there... You know, don't you?」

682:t_2:30.en:
$$ベック$$
「That the real name of the $$ノノリリ$$ you admire is $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$.」

682:t_2:34.en:
$$シン$$
「But she's nothing like the $$ノノリリ$$ that $$ノノ$$ described!」

682:t_2:35.en:
$$カレン$$
「Didn't $$ノノリリ$$ have long, beautiful hair, a gorgeous body, and a Holy Mother's smile?!」

682:t_2:36.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...I think that's probably because, over the long years, $$ノノ$$'s memories of $$ノリコ$$ and $$カズミ$$ became mixed together.」

682:t_2:37.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But now I'm certain. $$ノノリリ$$, the girl who fought with humanity's future on her shoulders... was you, $$ノリコ$$.」

682:t_2:38.en:
$$チコ$$
「Then our world wasn't a parallel world to $$ノリコ$$'s, but a much later era...?」

682:t_2:39.en:
$$ベック$$
「Looks that way. Seems roughly 12,000 years have passed.」

682:t_2:40.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Why do you know that?」

682:t_2:41.en:
$$ベック$$
「When I was with $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$, I saw the records he... or rather, $$サイデリアル$$, had obtained from the ruins at the edge of the solar system.」

682:t_2:42.en:
$$ベック$$
「Apparently, those ruins were a collection of technologies that one of the worlds making up $$翠の地球$$ had sealed away in the past.」

682:t_2:43.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So those came from our world's past... In other words, from $$ノリコ$$'s era.」

682:t_2:44.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$ and I weren't thrown into a parallel world. We drifted into the future, 12,000 years later...」

682:t_2:45.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Now it all makes sense, even why the $$バスター軍団$$ had a degeneracy reactor that $$ガンバスター$$ could use.」

682:t_2:46.en:
$$チコ$$
「Our world forgot about the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and mistook the $$バスター軍団$$ for the legendary $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

682:t_2:47.en:
$$ベック$$
「Seems so. And since the old technology was dangerous, they built an entirely new technological system.」

682:t_2:48.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So that's what our $$バスターマシン$$s, powered by $$トップレス$$ abilities, are...」

682:t_2:50.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$! If you knew that, why did you keep quiet?!」

682:t_2:51.en:
$$ラルク$$
「She was the $$ノノリリ$$ you admired, wasn't she?! You should've called $$ノリコ$$ Big Sis, instead of someone like me!」

682:t_2:52.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...$$ノノ$$ felt the same as Big Sis... $$ノノ$$... hated herself for not being able to become $$ノノリリ$$...」

682:t_2:54.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's why $$ノノ$$... thought she would forget about $$ノノリリ$$ and go on living...」

682:t_2:55.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's a lie! You always gave it everything you had! With hard work and guts!」

682:t_2:56.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You left me behind, and I fell into despair, but you kept moving forward!」

682:t_2:57.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's why I... You shone so brightly to me...」

682:t_2:58.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But Big Sis kept fighting... You never ran away, and fought with hard work and guts...」

682:t_2:59.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's why Big Sis really is $$ノノリリ$$... the person I admire.」

682:t_2:61.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...I'm always... like this, really... $$ノノ$$ really is hopeless...」

682:t_2:62.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No matter how much power $$ノノ$$ gains, she's still just a flame... When a strong wind blows, she immediately wavers.」

682:t_2:63.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But if Big Sis were here with me...」

682:t_2:65.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Move, No. 7!! Stay out of my way!!」

682:t_2:66.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I won't rely on someone like you when I don't even know where you came from! This is humanity's fight!」

682:t_2:68.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Humanity will survive, even if we have to throw the Earth away! I don't know if it's right...! You have nothing to do with this!」

682:t_2:69.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You... You don't even know how I feel...! You...!!」

682:t_2:71.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You only had to stay my friend! I wanted you to call me $$ラルク$$, instead of Big Sis!」

682:t_2:72.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But you...! You kept getting stronger all on your own, and left me behind...!」

682:t_2:74.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I... can't be the person you admire! I can't be $$ノノリリ$$!」

682:t_2:76.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...$$ノノ$$ can't become $$ノノリリ$$ either...」

682:t_2:78.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$... wanted to be like Big Sis... $$ノノ$$ was always jealous of you...」

682:t_2:79.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because... Big Sis is so much like $$ノノリリ$$...」

682:t_2:81.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノリリ$$ isn't someone special... She's an ordinary girl...」

682:t_2:82.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Fighting alongside $$ノリコ$$ in person made that very clear to me.」

682:t_2:84.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes... $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$ is the real name of the $$ノノリリ$$ I admired.」

682:t_2:87.en:
$$シン$$
「But she's nothing like the $$ノノリリ$$ that $$ノノ$$ described!」

682:t_2:88.en:
$$カレン$$
「Didn't $$ノノリリ$$ have long, beautiful hair, a gorgeous body, and a Holy Mother's smile?!」

682:t_2:89.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...I think that's probably because, over the long years, $$ノノ$$'s memories of $$ノリコ$$ and $$カズミ$$ became mixed together.」

682:t_2:90.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But now I'm certain. $$ノノリリ$$, the girl who fought with humanity's future on her shoulders... was you, $$ノリコ$$.」

682:t_2:91.en:
$$チコ$$
「Then our world wasn't a parallel world to $$ノリコ$$'s, but a much later era...?」

682:t_2:92.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It seems so... Apparently about 12,000 years have passed.」

682:t_2:93.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Where did you hear that, Princess?」

682:t_2:94.en:
$$ラルク$$
「At the $$枢密参謀院$$, after the Galactic Raid Fleet set sail...」

682:t_2:95.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Apparently, the technology used in $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$ is the same as the technology in the ruins at the edge of the solar system.」

682:t_2:96.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So those came from our world's past... In other words, from $$ノリコ$$'s era.」

682:t_2:97.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$ and I weren't thrown into a parallel world. We drifted into the future, 12,000 years later...」

682:t_2:98.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Now it all makes sense, even why the $$バスター軍団$$ had a degeneracy reactor that $$ガンバスター$$ could use.」

682:t_2:99.en:
$$チコ$$
「Our world forgot about the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and mistook the $$バスター軍団$$ for the legendary $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

682:t_2:100.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Apparently, people in later eras built an entirely new technological system because the technology from $$ノリコ$$'s time was dangerous.」

682:t_2:101.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So that's what our $$バスターマシン$$s, powered by $$トップレス$$ abilities, are...」

682:t_2:103.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$... You knew about that, didn't you?」

682:t_2:104.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes... My memories gradually began returning around the time I regained $$バスターマシン７号$$'s power...」

682:t_2:106.en:
$$ラルク$$
「She was the $$ノノリリ$$ you admired, wasn't she?! You should've called $$ノリコ$$ Big Sis, instead of someone like me!」

682:t_2:107.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...$$ノノ$$ felt the same as Big Sis... $$ノノ$$... hated herself for not being able to become $$ノノリリ$$...」
